value.message: Native Translation refers to multilingual support where the model generates responses directly in the selected language, without the need of external translation services. This ensures more seamless, context-aware, and accurate outputs for end users across supported languages.

Dynamic Translation enables you to configure localization support in real-time across your instance. User-entered text is translated dynamically in Now Assist applications in order to support users who speak different languages.

composition.elementLabel: What if I enable both Native and Dynamic translation?

value.message: When both translations are enabled, Native translation takes precedence and will be used first.

composition.elementLabel: How do I choose the translation service?

value.message: Consider factors such as translation quality and turnaround time to determine the best service for your needs.

composition.elementLabel: Difference between Dynamic Translation and native translation Accordion Item

value.message: Dynamic Translation uses a translator service provided by ServiceNow to translate text in Now Assist applications and skills. Native translation uses the translation capabilities of the Now LLM Service to translate content.

Dynamic Translation uses a translator service provided by ServiceNow to translate text in Now Assist applications and skills. Native translation uses the translation capabilities of the Now LLM Service to translate content.

Turning off Dynamic Translation means that messages sent in Now Assist applications and skills will no longer be translated. If you have multi-lingual LLM support turned on, then any languages not covered by the LLM will no longer be supported.

Turning on Dynamic Translation for Now Assist means that you can enable language support for a variety of languages, including languages that are not supported by the multi-lingual LLM.  Dynamic Translation for Now Assist and streaming are incompatible. If you have enabled streaming for any AI assistants, it will be turned off.
Turn on Dynamic Translation for Now Assist?
Disabling native translation will prevent the Now LLM Service from providing translations to the preferred languages of your users in Now Assist applications and skills.
If you switch, all Now Assist applications and skills will use ServiceNow as the language service.
